notes: This metric is not prediction accuracy. It measures the capture rate among imported official final games.
Missing game predictions are counted only after the official final enters local data.
Historical games before monitoring launch are excluded from this prospective capture rate.
GitHub scheduled jobs are best effort; missed windows must not be backdated.
Shadow records never count as additional original forecasts.
prospective_capture.scope: Only official completed MLB games already imported by the cloud service

two_stage_comparison.notes: Paired same-version comparisons only; transitions between model versions are excluded to avoid confusing new coefficients with fresher pregame data.
